newsitem.title: USA: Copper spreads tight, other LME metals ease.
newsitem.headline: Copper spreads tight, other LME metals ease.

text.p: COPPER - Spreads still dominant. Cash/one trades at $24, cash/one week at $100, both premiums. Cash/threes backwardation indicated at steep $330/340. Forward market neglected at lower levels.
ALUMINIUM - Holding above $1,625 support. ALLOY - Quiet.
NICKEL - Matches softer trend. TIN - Slips towards $5,900
LEAD - Dull, price easier. ZINC - Also lower.
